summary: Path-string registration helper: normalizes trailing backslashes on the input path a1 via PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer, then returns the integer result of copying the normalized string through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc. Called by ConfigIniParser.

local_names.a1: input path string to normalize and register

operations.description: Calls PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer(a1) to normalize trailing backslashes on the input path string.
Calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1) to copy the normalized path string into a realloc-managed buffer.
Returns the integer result of StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1).
Reached from ConfigIniParser (00421CD0) as one of a chain of path-registration helpers.
